title: Inspect and extend: Operate the relay without exposing a control port
objective: Use the real implementation in `server/index.js` to demonstrate and safely improve safe defaults, trusted lan warning, robotjs native dependency, and shutdown/review.
problem: Remote keyboard/mouse is powerful. Learn to keep the relay local, review every opt-in before a LAN demo, and account for native robotjs build requirements and host permissions. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `server/index.js` and the related project files: server/config.js; server/index.js; README.md.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to safe defaults, trusted lan warning, robotjs native dependency, and shutdown/review.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: No pairing, TLS, client authentication, or internet-safe deployment is included.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Remote keyboard/mouse is powerful. Learn to keep the relay local, review every opt-in before a LAN demo, and account for native robotjs build requirements and host permissions.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `server/index.js`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
